page_title: HAV 2-1 CLE | Le Havre v Clermont 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Mathieu Vernice has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
90+4' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

90+3' Andy Logbo (Le Havre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mathieu Vernice no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Clermont.
90+1' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Le Havre have a free kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Jim Allevinah will be replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
88' Here comes a substitution. Daler Kuzyaev is given a rest as he is replaced by Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre).
85' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alidu Seidu (Clermont) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) on for Yassine Kechta.
83' A substitution has been made. Maxime Gonalons goes off and Habib Keita (Clermont) comes on.
83' Here is a change. Muhammed Cham is going off and Pascal Gastien gives the last tactical orders to Grejohn Kyei (Clermont).
82' Josue Casimir doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
82' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar!
78' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Clermont players are visibly unhappy with the call. Clermont will take a free kick.
77' There's a break in play and referee Mathieu Vernice must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Clermont using VAR. This could be interesting!
76' Surely that's handball by one of the Le Havre players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
75' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
74' Substitution. Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) makes his way off the pitch and Andy Logbo comes on as his replacement.
74' That's the end of the game for Nabil Alioui, who is replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
73' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) replacing Cheick Oumar Konate.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) comes onto the pitch so that Johan Gastien can be given a rest.
72' Clermont take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

68' A neat pass is well received by Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
65' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call. That's a free kick to Clermont.
65' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
63' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
62' Flag goes up against Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

60' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul. Free kick. Le Havre will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
58' Clermont win a corner.
56' The ball possession is 31:69.
53' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
52' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
50' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
47' A snap shot by Muhammed Cham (Clermont) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Arthur Desmas produces a good save to thwart him.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+1' 2 - 1 Goal! Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the right post. It's 2:1.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
43' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
40' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
39' Mathieu Vernice couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) and blew his whistle. Le Havre win a free kick.

34' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
34' Le Havre force a corner. They send men into the box.

34' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Le Havre are going to take it.

31' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the left side of the goal, but Arthur Desmas denies him with a great save.

29' The game is interrupted. Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Clermont win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
27' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
26' The game is interrupted now, Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Poor challenge! Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is penalised for tripping and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
22' Mathieu Vernice shows a yellow card to Johan Gastien (Clermont) for his blatant foul.
19' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
15' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) makes a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. Le Havre have a free kick.
13' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Le Havre get a free kick.
12' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. Clermont are awarded the free kick.
9' Clermont will take a corner kick.
8' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Yohan Magnin (Clermont) inside the box. Good work from Clermont as they win a corner.

7' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Josue Casimir, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre), who beats Mory Diaw with a brilliant shot into the top left corner. 2:0.
5' Dangerous play by Johan Gastien (Clermont). Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. Le Havre win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Josue Casimir puts a cross into the box and finds Nabil Alioui (Le Havre), who latches on to it and strikes the ball low into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.
2' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
1' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) was too forceful with his tackle and Mathieu Vernice interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Le Havre in a dangerous position.
1' The first half has just begun.
Le Havre will kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice was nominated as the referee for this game.
